vermillion.$description: Vermillion — Orange accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

peach-hairline.$description: Peach Hairline — Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cream-vellum.$description: Cream Vellum — Page canvas below the hero, input borders, soft surface washes — the warm paper stock everything else sits on

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Card surfaces, button fills on the orange hero, nav text on dark/orange, inverted typography — the bright surface layer

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary headings, body text, dark section backgrounds, chat bubble fills, button borders on light — the heavy type and the rare full-bleed dark band

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card borders, secondary text, muted UI rules — the mid-neutral that softens edges between Bone White and Midnight Ink

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Link text on light surfaces, image strokes, secondary borders

ochre-tan.$description: Ochre Tan — Badge backgrounds and borders, secondary surface tint — a warm neutral tag fill that sits between cream and peach

press-black.$description: Press Black — Icon fills, tight border accents, true-black for print-style contrast moments

instrument-sans.$description: Primary interface and editorial typeface. Weight 500 for nav and buttons, weight 600 for headings, weight 400 for body. Consistent -0.02em tracking across all sizes tightens the geometric forms and gives the warm palette a modern editorial voice. The slight positive tracking at caption (12px) opens up small labels so they don't feel crushed.

fragment-mono.$description: Accent monospace for timestamps in chat bubbles, metadata labels, and small data tags. The extreme -0.08em tracking at 14px collapses letterforms into a dense printed-stamp feel that contrasts the airy sans-serif body.
